_readme: Baseline for scripts/backtest.py. Scores are the pre-direction-fix scores read off the device on 2026-08-14, before calculateOverallScore started weighting source implication. scanned_price is what the app reported at scan time. Run `python3 scripts/backtest.py snapshot` to fill in baseline_price, then `check` in ~30 days.
_price_matching_caveat: baseline_price is the HIGHEST market price across all printings of that card name, so it often names a different (pricier) printing than the one the app scanned - Dark Machamp reads $144 here against the app's ~$12 non-holo, and Slowbro $242 against the app's $1-25 range. That is fine for this test: it measures MOVEMENT, and the same query returns the same printing on the next run. Do not read baseline_price as 'what the scanned card is worth'.
